name: sui-sdks
description: Sui SDK landscape — which SDK to pick (TypeScript, Rust, or community-maintained Python/Go/Dart/Kotlin/Swift), how they map to each other, and how to install and wire each one up. Use when a user is starting a new Sui project in any language, migrating between languages, comparing APIs across SDKs, or asking "what SDK should I use for X?". For deep patterns inside a single SDK, route to that SDK's reference file.
